This file owns the `member of [R1..Rn]` constraints and the stored `choice_regions` that `region_infer` minimizes over, so it is the immediate data source for the faulty lifetime-selection behavior.

The bug is exposed through async opaque types (`impl Future`) and hidden-type lifetime capture, and this module is the opaque-type postprocessing path that maps inferred regions back to named lifetimes after region inference.

The problematic `choice_regions = ['static, 'a, 'b, 'c]` ordering comes from the universal-region setup, so this file is a likely upstream contributor to the region set and its iteration/order semantics.

This module turns type-checker outlives/member information into the borrowck region structures used later by `region_infer`, so it is a plausible place where opaque-type or closure constraints enter the failing path.

It builds the initial universal-region relation environment from declared and implied outlives bounds, which is directly relevant to the lifetime-ordering-sensitive relation graph described in the bug.

This is the shared outlives-constraint storage/SCC layer consumed by region inference; if the member-constraint minimization depends on constraint structure or SCC remapping, this module is part of that path.
It exposes the region outlives graph used by inference and special-cases `'static`, so it is a supporting candidate for bugs involving region ordering and reachability over universal regions.

This is the main MIR type-checking driver that produces the region, liveness, member, and type-test inputs later consumed by region inference, so it is an important upstream source for the bad constraint set.
